MonkeStation 2.0 - Modules - Types — Var Details - Proc Details

ipc_screen
/obj/item/organ/external/ipc_screen

An IPC's face display. Stores the chosen sprite, blanks on death and restores it on revival.

Vars

blank_screen_timerPending timer which blanks the display after death.
change_screenThe innate action that IPCs receive while this screen is installed.
restore_screen_timerPending timer which restores the saved display after revival.
saved_screenThe display restored after the IPC finishes rebooting.
screen_iconIcon containing the full-size display art used by IPC screen overlays.

Procs

blank_dead_screenBlanks a dead IPC's screen if this organ is still installed when the timer fires.
bsod_deathMakes the IPC screen switch to BSOD followed by a blank screen.
cancel_screen_timersCancels any delayed screen transition owned by this organ.
on_reviveStarts the IPC's display reboot sequence after revival.
restore_saved_screenRestores the display which was active before death.
switch_to_screenSwitches an installed IPC screen and updates the owner's appearance.
valid_screen_ownerReturns whether this organ is still the installed screen belonging to screen_owner.

Proc Details

proc
blank_dead_screen
(/mob/living/carbon/human/transformer)

Blanks a dead IPC's screen if this organ is still installed when the timer fires.

proc
bsod_death
(/mob/living/carbon/human/transformer, gibbed)

Makes the IPC screen switch to BSOD followed by a blank screen.

Arguments:

  • transformer - The IPC whose display is changing.
  • gibbed - Whether the death was caused by gibbing. The screen behavior is the same either way.

proc
cancel_screen_timers
()

Cancels any delayed screen transition owned by this organ.

proc
on_revive
(/mob/living/carbon/human/transformer, full_heal, admin_revive)

Starts the IPC's display reboot sequence after revival.

proc
restore_saved_screen
(/mob/living/carbon/human/transformer)

Restores the display which was active before death.

proc
switch_to_screen
(/mob/living/carbon/human/transformer, screen_name, color_choice)

Switches an installed IPC screen and updates the owner's appearance.

Arguments:

  • transformer - The IPC whose display will be changed.
  • screen_name - The sprite-accessory name to display.
  • color_choice - Optional new display color. Null preserves the existing color.

proc
valid_screen_owner
(/mob/living/carbon/human/screen_owner)

Returns whether this organ is still the installed screen belonging to screen_owner.
